messages:
Priya (Docs): Quick FYI: I started a tiny docs PR to fix a few Dedicated provisioning items: broken internal links, an out-of-date TypeScript SDK snippet, and the autoscale example that still uses snake_case fields. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4621
Marcus (ENG): thanks — which fields in the autoscale example are wrong?
Priya (Docs): the YAML uses `scalePolicy` and `tenant_id`. We migrated to `scale_policies` (list) and `tenant_label`. Also the example mentions 'preemption' without clarifying reserved vs burst pools.
Talia (Infra): I can paste a compact corrected YAML. Keep it short for the handbook:
Talia (Infra): ```yaml
annotations:
  redwood.com/isolation: "reserved-pool"
scale_policies:
  - name: default
    min_replicas: 1
    max_replicas: 8
```
Diego (ML): small content note: the "quantization tips" paragraph references a model family we no longer recommend. Suggest replacing with: "Prefer per-workload quant profiles; run a perf vs quality sweep before applying globally." Two sentences is enough.
Marcus (ENG): agree. Also we should add a one-liner migration callout at the top: "Breaking changes: scalePolicy -> scale_policies; createDedicatedPool -> reserveCapacity (TS SDK)."
Priya (Docs): done. I'm adding a migration section with examples of the old vs new payloads. Keeping them under 6 lines each.
Talia (Infra): on eviction precedence, can we include a 2-column list: "reserved-pool: not preempted by shared; shared: preempted when capacity constrained"? Simple bullet list would suffice.
Diego (ML): for the SDK snippet: TS used to call `createDedicatedPool({})`. New API returns `{ poolId }` from `reserveCapacity`. I'll attach the updated snippet in the PR.
Priya (Docs): thanks — I'll also update the small TypeScript snippet and add a note about the return shape.
doc-bot: lint: markdown links check passed on branch priya/provisioning-cleanup :white_check_mark:
Marcus (ENG): one more ask: can we keep the autoscale example under 30 lines and link to a longer recipe elsewhere? Saves scrolling.
Talia (Infra): I'll trim comments and move the long rationale to an appendix file.
Priya (Docs): plan: push commit w/ 1) fixed anchors, 2) trimmed autoscale YAML (Talia's), 3) TS SDK snippet update (Diego's), 4) short migration callout, 5) replace deprecated quant paragraph. ETA: EOD. Will ping reviewers when up. :rocket:
